Add an OpenStreetMap Address & Place Search Bar (add_search_osm, search_options)

Source: R/controls.R
add_search_osm.Rd

Drop-in equivalent of leaflet.extras::addSearchOSM() and leaflet.extras::searchOptions(). Adds an interactive address/place geocoder bar powered by OpenStreetMap Nominatim with autocomplete suggestions, Enter-to-search, smooth camera fly-to, and an optional location pin.

Usage

add_search_osm(map, options = search_options(), position = NULL, order = 5)

search_options(
  url = "https://nominatim.openstreetmap.org/search?format=json&q={s}",
  zoom = 15,
  autoCollapse = FALSE,
  textPlaceholder = "Search address or place...",
  position = "topleft",
  hideMarkerOnCollapse = TRUE,
  ...
)

Arguments

map

A glmap widget or glmap_proxy.

options

Search configuration list created by search_options().

position

Anchor position (default "topleft").

order

Numeric draw order within the anchor zone (default 5).

url

Geocoding endpoint URL template containing {s} (default Nominatim JSON endpoint).

zoom

Target zoom level when flying to a matched address (default 15).

autoCollapse

Logical; if TRUE, collapses the search input until clicked (default FALSE).

textPlaceholder

Placeholder text inside the search input.

hideMarkerOnCollapse

Logical; remove the search pin when cleared (default TRUE).

...

Additional options ignored for leaflet.extras::searchOptions() compatibility.

Value

Updated glmap widget or glmap_proxy.
